info.name: LedgerOne - Accounting (Tax)
info.description:
Accounting module (Tax Group, Tax Rule) API collection (Create, Get, Update, List Tax Group; Create, Get, List Tax Rule). Reflects the implementation exactly as shipped in apps/api/src/shared/accounting.

Design note (both entities are tenant-owned, unlike Currency): Tax Group (00_BUSINESS_RULES.md Ch.67.13's "Finance Manager or Company Administrator approval" implies Company-level configuration) and Tax Rule (mirrors its parent's ownership) both require X-Tenant-Id on every request, like Financial Year/Fiscal Period/Exchange Rate — unlike Currency's platform-owned no-header posture.

Design note (repeatable naming/dates): Tax Group's name is unique per Company (uq_tax_groups_tenant_company_name_deleted_at) with no delete endpoint to clean up via the API itself, and Tax Rule's effective date range must not overlap another rule for the same Tax Group (00_BUSINESS_RULES.md Ch.68.7 TXR-001). A collection-level pre-request script derives a numeric {{txSuffix}} (from the current timestamp) for Tax Group names and a distinct {{txYear}} date window for Tax Rule effective dates, once per Newman invocation — so two separate runs never collide on either uniqueness rule. Test data is still deleted directly via SQL after a verification pass, matching every other Accounting collection's established cleanup convention.

Design note (immutability): Tax Rule has no update/remove endpoint at all (00_BUSINESS_RULES.md Ch.68.7 TXR-003 — a rate correction requires a new, dated rule), mirroring Exchange Rate's own historical-immutability posture — the two 'Immutable Tax Rule' requests confirm this is a genuine unmounted Express route (HTML 404), not a JSON domain error.

Run order for a full pass, top to bottom: the entire Tax Group folder before the Tax Rule folder — {{taxGroupUuid}}/{{secondTaxGroupUuid}} must both be set (by 'Create Primary Tax Group - Success' and 'Create Second Tax Group - Success') before any Tax Rule request runs.
